Summary: The ManuRAG dataset comprises a total of 1,515 question-answer pairs, including 309 mathematical QA pairs, 471 multiple-choice QA pairs, and 735 review-based QA pairs, all derived from "Fundamentals of Modern Manufacturing" Groover (2010). These datasets are used to benchmark the performance of ManuRAG, which consistently outperforms existing methods across all evaluated datasets, demonstrating its adaptability to other domains such as law, healthcare, and finance.
